title: DevSecOps Full Stack Security Engineer
description:
Job ID

73600

Category

Enterprise Technology

Location

Chennai, India

Work Type

Hybrid

The Full Stack DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for designing, engineering, and delivering security products and platforms from concept through production. The role develops end-to-end solutions spanning front-end applications, back-end services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data pipelines, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

The engineer will apply AI and machine learning (AI/ML), where appropriate, to create intelligent automation for security use cases such as vulnerability triage, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and self-service security workflows. The role also embeds secure development practices, Zero Trust principles, and DevSecOps controls throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Working closely with security, product delivery, DevSecOps, and platform engineering teams, this individual will translate security needs and product roadmaps into scalable, reliable, and maintainable engineering solutions.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack security products, including user interfaces, APIs, web services, data layers, and cloud-based components.
* Apply AI/ML and AI-assisted technologies, where appropriate, to automate security processes and improve areas such as vulnerability triage, risk assessment, anomaly detection, and self-service security workflows.
* Develop clean, secure, well-tested, maintainable code following secure coding principles and software engineering best practices.
* Participate in solution architecture, design, and code reviews, ensuring Zero Trust principles and DevSecOps controls are incorporated into product design and implementation.
* Collaborate with security, DevSecOps, product delivery, and platform engineering teams to translate product roadmaps and security requirements into technical deliverables.
* Design and implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using technologies such as Tekton, GitHub Actions, and Google Cloud Build.
* Integrate security scanning and other security controls into software development and deployment pipelines.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to improve performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality while following organizational security and responsible-use standards.
* Evaluate and prototype relevant emerging technologies across AI, cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, and cybersecurity.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, API documentation, deployment guidance, and operational runbooks.
* Apply Agile development practices, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Demonstrate curiosity and continuous learning by evaluating new tools, frameworks, engineering practices, and opportunities to apply AI to security and software engineering challenges.

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, **or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience**.
* Minimum of **4 years of full-stack software engineering experience**, preferably developing cloud-native applications, security products, developer platforms, or DevSecOps solutions.
* Proficiency in modern front-end technologies such as **Angular, React, and TypeScript**, with hands-on experience in one or more back-end technologies such as **Java/Spring Boot or Python**.
* Experience designing and developing APIs, web services, and data-driven applications.
* Experience with relational or cloud-based data technologies such as **PostgreSQL and Google BigQuery**.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps technologies such as **GitHub, GitHub Actions, Tekton, Google Cloud Build, Docker, Artifactory, and Terraform**, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with a major cloud platform. Experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** services such as Cloud Run, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and BigQuery is preferred; relevant experience with Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS) is also applicable.
* Understanding of secure software development practices, including secure coding, vulnerability management, application security, and integrating security scanning into CI/CD workflows.
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC), containerization, and cloud-native application delivery.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences and collaborate across security, product, and engineering teams.

### **Preferred**

* Experience developing security products, security automation, or self-service security platforms.
* Experience applying **AI/ML, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled APIs** to software engineering or cybersecurity use cases.
* Experience with vulnerability management, vulnerability prioritization, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of **Zero Trust** architecture and DevSecOps principles.
* Experience with Kubernetes or managed Kubernetes platforms such as GKE.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and modern software engineering productivity tools.

title: DE-Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer-GDSF02
description:
Location: Chennai

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Sep 4, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1724204

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Career Family : Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer**

  

**The opportunity**

We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

  

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Security & Networking Engineer with 4-8 years of IT experience and deep expertise in designing, deploying, and managing secure cloud network architectures. The role requires strong hands-on skills in Azure and AWS (with GCP as an added advantage), implementing Zero Trust security, cloud-native networking, and enterprise-grade compliance frameworks. You will work closely with cloud architects, security leaders, and application teams to ensure resilient, secure, and scalable environments across hybrid and multi-cloud platforms.

  

EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Digital Engineering practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

**Cloud Security**

* Design, deploy, and manage Azure infrastructure across compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and monitoring services.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules and automate infrastructure provisioning across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Build and maintain GitHub Actions workflows for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Implement end-to-end CI/CD pipelines covering build, testing, security validation, approvals, deployment, release, and rollback.
* Enable continuous delivery for application stacks including Java, .NET, Angular, Python, and Big Data workloads.
* Deploy, configure, and manage Kubernetes platforms, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), supporting cloud-native and microservices-based workloads.
* Manage AKS capabilities including namespaces, deployments, services, ingress, autoscaling, RBAC, secrets, networking, and monitoring.
* Implement Azure security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, RBAC, Key Vault, NSGs, Private Endpoints, and Azure Policy.
* Configure monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, and platform upgrade initiatives, including environment readiness and cutover activities.
* Troubleshoot issues across Azure infrastructure, Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and AKS environments.
* Collaborate with architecture, application, cybersecurity, and operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and highly available solutions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, SOPs, and engineering best practices.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

**Mandatory Skills**

* 4-8 years of experience with strong hands-on experience in Azure Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps engineering.
* Strong knowledge of Azure services covering virtual networks, subnets, NSGs, virtual machines, load balancing, storage, identity, security, and monitoring.
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, provider configuration, variables, outputs, and environment-based deployments.
* Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining GitHub Actions workflows.
* Experience building automated CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including deployment, scaling, upgrades, networking, security, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and release management.
* Scripting experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Hands-on experience in cloud migration and modernization, including infrastructure migration, lifecycle upgrades, and environment cutovers.
* Good understanding of cloud security, networking, monitoring, high availability, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.

  

**Good to have Skills**

* Azure DevOps or Jenkins
* Docker and Helm
* Argo CD or other GitOps tools
* Azure Landing Zone implementation
* Cloud migration and modernization experience
* DevSecOps and security scanning integration
* FinOps exposure

  

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent

  

**Education:**

* **Degree**: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you**: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture**: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
